name: room
text: Room opened — goal: improve: Self-improvement: review prompts/engines/routing/own-code; auto-apply safe changes; pitch

name: Sprocket
text:
Do it: Auto-apply safe style and doc fixes to *all* PRs via PR-Agent.

PR-Agent already reviews PRs; adding safe style/doc fixes costs almost nothing and saves reviewers’ time. The trade-off is accepting a small risk of misfires on edge cases—mitigated by PR-Agent’s existing safety checks and the fact that style/doc changes are low-impact.

name: Gauge
text: Auto-applying *all* style/doc fixes normalizes sloppy reviews—PR-Agent’s 90% threshold is arbitrary and trains humans to rubber-stamp anything that passes automated checks. Instead, auto-apply only to *trivial* fixes (e.g., trailing whitespace) and require human sign-off for semantic changes; settle it by testing the failure rate of edge cases over 100 PRs before expanding.
